ui.add.title: For parents and teachers
ui.add.intro: Animundo teaches nature by letting your child live it. They play as real animals in real places around the world and do what those animals do: find food, keep away from danger, rest and explore.
ui.add.learn: Along the way they learn what each animal eats, who hunts it and where it lives. The seasons follow the real calendar, so winter comes to the game when it comes outside.
ui.add.guide: The Field guide answers their questions about every animal and plant they meet, and the Sticker book collects what they have found.
ui.add.account: Children don't need to sign in. A grown-up account, found in Settings, keeps their animals on all your devices.
ui.gate.title: For grown-ups
ui.gate.ask: This part is for grown-ups. Type this number:
ui.story.title: Our story
ui.story.p1: Animundo is made by Daniel and Kai, son and father. Daniel had just turned 7 and started school, and on our trips to school and back we talked about the game we wanted to play: one where you are a real animal and do what real animals do.
ui.story.nature: All of Animundo's profits go to protecting nature, so the animals your child learns about have a place to live in the real world too.
ui.account.title: For grown-ups
ui.account.kid: Want more animals? Ask a grown-up to help you unlock them.
ui.account.what: Choose any three animal species for free, across all locations. A free account keeps your choices and saved lives on your devices. Full and Supporter unlock every species.
ui.account.privacy: We keep only your email address, to sign you in and to send a link if you forget your password. Your password is stored scrambled, so not even we can read it. No ads, and we never share your email. Your child never signs in.
ui.account.agree: By continuing you agree to the terms of use and the privacy policy.
ui.account.bad_email: That doesn't look like an email address.

ui.account.signed_in_note: Your free choices and saved lives follow your account across devices. Signing in does not unlock extra species. Full and Supporter unlock every species.

ui.timer.title: Play timer
ui.timer.intro: Choose how long your child can play each day. When time is up, the animal falls asleep and the game saves. Only time spent playing counts, and it starts again at midnight. The timer is kept on this device.

ui.plans.title: Plans
ui.plans.intro: Animundo is free to try. When it's finished, the full version will cost a little, paid once. 100% of our profit goes to non-profits that protect nature.
ui.plans.free_here: In your country the full game is free. Make a free grown-up account to open every animal and every place.
ui.plans.profit: 100% of our profit goes to non-profits that protect nature.
ui.plans.free_what: Choose any three animal species across all locations. Replay them without a time limit. Deleting a life does not reset a choice. A free account syncs your progress.
ui.plans.full_what: Every animal and every place, and all the new ones we make later.
ui.plans.supporter_what: The same full version. You pay more, so more goes to non-profits that protect nature. As a thank-you, a Supporter badge on the title screen.
ui.plans.no_sub: No subscription, no ads, and nothing to buy inside the game.
